status: One prespecified score per endpoint; no benchmark ranking or participant-level non-overlap certification.
selection_rule: Use the prespecified score with CTN and PC-varying marginal-slope survival. No score or model search; keep the outer test locked during development.
provenance_rule: Audit discovery GWAS, component scores and supervised tuning. Prior AoU evaluation is distinct from development. Undisclosed cross-enrollment cannot be excluded by public cohort names.

PGS004525.reported_development: UK Biobank; disease and risk-factor meta-score

discovery.evidence: GWAS of 247 diseases and 112 risk factors were run by the authors in a UK Biobank White British unrelated GWAS set (n=174,488); no external summary statistics and no All of Us samples are used (Xu et al. 2024, Methods).

components.evidence: Risk-factor PRSs (LDpred) and disease PRSs were estimated in the disjoint UK Biobank PRS set (n=174,489); PGS Catalog records the training cohort as UKB, European, n=174,489.

tuning.evidence: Elastic-net meta-score weights were fitted in the UK Biobank PRS set and the meta-score validated in an independent UK Biobank set (n=56,192); the paper contains no mention of All of Us. Undisclosed cross-enrollment between UK Biobank and All of Us cannot be excluded from public cohort names.
